select 
	V.documentcode, 
	type = V.documenttype + '-' + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), V.documentcode))), 
	date = V.date, 
	debit = V.Debit,
	credit= V.Credit,
	remark = CASE V.documenttype
				WHEN 'PV' THEN
					(SELECT	RTRIM(LTRIM(P.SuppInvCode)) + 
								CASE WHEN LEN(RTRIM(LTRIM(P.SuppInvCode))) > 0 THEN ', ' ELSE '' END + 
								RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(Varchar(12), SuppInvDate))) + 
								CASE WHEN LEN(RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(Varchar(12), SuppInvDate)))) > 0 THEN ', ' ELSE '' END + 
								RTRIM(LTRIM(P.Remarks))
					FROM PurLedger P
					WHERE P.PurinvCode = V.DocumentCode)
				WHEN 'PR' THEN
					(SELECT RTRIM(LTRIM(P.Remarks))
					FROM PrLedger P
					WHERE P.PurinvCode = V.DocumentCode) ELSE V.Remarks END,
	Supplier=S.name,
	cash = case ISNULL(v.AlternateAccCode, -1) when -1 then 'N' else 'Y' end,
	S.aliasname,
	address=S.address1,
	openbalance=(select isnull(sum(debit-credit), 0) from virtualgl 
			where	virtualgl.acccode=S.acccode and 
				virtualgl.date < :ar_startdate),
	V.CheckNo,
	V.VRow,
	V.vouchercode,
	PendingCheque=0
from     
	VirtualGL V,
	(SELECT	a.aliasname, a.acccode, a.name, sp.address1
	FROM	accounts a, supplier sp
	WHERE	a.acccode IN (:ar_suppcode) and 
			a.acccode = sp.suppcode) S
WHERE
	(V.AccCode = S.AccCode OR V.AlternateAccCode = S.AccCode ) and
	V.date BETWEEN :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate AND
	V.DocumentType NOT IN ('PV', 'PR', 'SP', 'RP')
union all
select 
	documentcode=NULL, 
	type = 'PV', 
	date = :ar_enddate, 
	debit = 0.00,
	credit= SUM(V.Credit) - SUM(V.Debit),
	remark = 'Periodic Purchases-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(Count(DISTINCT V.DocumentType + STR(V.DocumentCode))))) + ' (' + LTRIM(RTRIM(MIN(STR(V.DocumentCode)))) + '-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(MAX(STR(V.DocumentCode)))) + ')',
	Supplier=S.name,
	cash = 'N',
	S.aliasname,
	address=S.address1,
	openbalance=(select isnull(sum(debit-credit), 0) from virtualgl 
			where	virtualgl.acccode=S.acccode and 
				virtualgl.date < :ar_startdate),
	CheckNo=NULL,
	VRow=0,
	vouchercode=NULL,
	PendingCheque=0
from     
	VirtualGL V,
	(SELECT	a.aliasname, a.acccode, a.name, sp.address1
	FROM	accounts a, supplier sp
	WHERE	a.acccode IN (:ar_suppcode) and 
			a.acccode = sp.suppcode) S
WHERE
	(V.AccCode = S.AccCode OR V.AlternateAccCode = S.AccCode ) and
	V.date BETWEEN :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate AND
	V.DocumentType IN ('PV')
GROUP BY
	S.acccode, S.name, S.AliasName, S.address1
union all

SELECT 
	documentcode = N.NoteCode, 
	Type = Case N.NoteCatCode When 1 Then '*NR' Else '*NP' End + '-' + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), N.NoteCode))),  
	date = N.duedate, 
	debit = Case N.NoteCatCode When 1 Then CASE WHEN N.AccCode = S.AccCode THEN 0 ELSE N.Amount END ELSE CASE WHEN N.AccCode = S.AccCode THEN N.Amount ELSE 0 END END,
	credit= Case N.NoteCatCode When 1 Then CASE WHEN N.AccCode = S.AccCode THEN N.Amount ELSE 0 END ELSE CASE WHEN N.AccCode = S.AccCode THEN 0 ELSE N.Amount END END,
	remark = N.Remarks,
	S.name,
	cash = 'N',
	S.aliasname,
	address=S.address1+' '+S.address2+' '+S.city,
	openbalance=(select isnull(sum(debit-credit), 0) from virtualgl 
			where	virtualgl.acccode=S.acccode and 
				virtualgl.date < :ar_startdate),
	CheckNo = LEFT(N.DocumentNumber, 20),
	VRow=999999,
	VoucherCode=N.vouchercode,
	PendingCheque=1
from 
	Notes N,
	(SELECT	a.aliasname, a.acccode, a.name, sp.address1,sp.address2,sp.city
	FROM	accounts a, supplier sp
	WHERE	a.acccode IN (:ar_suppcode) and 
			a.acccode = sp.suppcode) S
where   
	(N.AccCode = S.AccCode OR N.BankAccCode = S.AccCode ) and
	N.Posted = 'N' AND N.Finalized = 'Y'
UNION ALL
select	
	documentcode=NULL, 
	type = NULL, 
	date = :ar_enddate, 
	debit = 0,
	credit= 0,
	remark = 'OPENING BALANCE',
	S.name,
	cash = 'N',
	S.aliasname,
	address=S.address1,
	openbalance=(select isnull(sum(debit-credit), 0) from virtualgl 
			where	virtualgl.acccode=S.acccode and 
				virtualgl.date < :ar_startdate),
	CheckNo=NULL,
	VRow=0,
	vouchercode=NULL,
	PendingCheque=0
from
	(SELECT	a.aliasname, a.acccode, a.name, sp.address1
	FROM	accounts a, supplier sp
	WHERE	a.acccode IN (:ar_suppcode) and 
			a.acccode = sp.suppcode AND 
			a.acccode NOT IN 
			(SELECT DISTINCT VGL.AccCode 
			FROM VirtualGL VGL 
			WHERE VGL.Date BETWEEN :ar_startdate AND :ar_enddate AND 
				VGL.AccCode IN (:ar_suppcode)
			UNION ALL
			SELECT DISTINCT N.AccCode 
			FROM Notes N
			WHERE N.Posted = 'N' AND N.Finalized='Y' AND
				N.AccCode IN (:ar_suppcode)
			UNION ALL
			SELECT DISTINCT N.BankAccCode 
			FROM Notes N
			WHERE N.Posted = 'N' AND N.Finalized='Y' AND
				N.AccCode IN (:ar_suppcode)) ) S
order by name, aliasname, date, type, VRow
